findings.entity: Dancer's arms and background mirror/door occlusion
findings.description: At 00:02, the foreground dancer's upper body becomes geometrically incompatible with the simultaneous view in the mirror and breaks depth ordering: the background mirror surface renders over and truncates her right arm at the elbow while a raised arm appears on her left shoulder (opposite to the mirror reflection, where her right arm is raised), and her lowered left tattooed forearm remains detached at her waist with the background doorframe visible above the elbow.
